Name: Buy Empty Joja Warehouse
Author: Kuchenkruste
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Ever felt that the Joja Warehouse is just a waste of space, while you struggle with the limited room on your farm?
This mod lets you [b]buy the Joja Warehouse[/b] after you've acquired your Joja Membership and turns it into an empty, freely furnishable building.

Need more room for machines, storage or planters? 
Want a bed close to town? 
Or do you just want more space to decorate? 

Set it up however you like!

[b][size=4]How to Use [/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Get your Joja Membership.[/*]
[*]The [b]Warehouse Deed[/b] is now available at [b]JojaMart[/b]. The default price is 100,000 g
(You can adjust the price in the config file or with [i]GenericModConfigMenu[/i]).[/*]
[*]Go to bed! In the night after buing the deed, Joja will fix up the warehouse for you.[/*]
[*]Enter the Warehouse. The building is empty and ready for your renovation project.[/*]
[/list]Until you buy the deed, the Warehouse stays as it is in the vanilla game.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Empty building with replaceable floors and wallpapers[/*]
[*]Beds can be placed and used for sleeping[/*]
[*]Movable windows and a fireplace, like in the starter house[/*]
[*]A kitchen[/*]
[*]A minecart station that lets you fast travel
(the Warehouse also appears as a destination in the other minecarts)[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list][b]Optional (recommended):[/b]
[list]
[*]Esca's Modding Plugins – bed placement and the kitchen[/*]
[*]Location Furniture – movable windows and fireplace[/*]
[/list](Without the optional mods the Warehouse still works, but those features may be missing.)

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]download the mod[/*]
[*]drag it into your mods folder and unzip[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Description: This Mod removes all the furniture inside the abondened Community Center once it become the Joja Warehouse.
